# Realistic secret-bearing lines. Each entry is `<input>\t<exact expected output>`.
# A line starting with '#' is a group header or comment; blank lines are ignored.
# Tabs separate input from expected, so no input may contain a tab.

# shell assignment, bare and spaced
export DB_PASSWORD="hunter2-canary"	export DB_PASSWORD=[redacted]
DB_PASSWORD = "hunter2-canary"	DB_PASSWORD = [redacted]
password='hunter2-canary'	password=[redacted]
password="hunter2-canary"suffix	password=[redacted]

# JSON / Python / escaped-JSON members
{"password":"hunter2-canary","user":"lando"}	{"password":"[redacted]","user":"lando"}
{'api_token': 'hunter2-canary'}	{'api_token': '[redacted]'}
{"db":{"password":"hunter2-canary"}}	{"db":{"password":"[redacted]"}}
{\"password\":\"hunter2-canary\"}	{\"password\":\"[redacted]\"}

# YAML block keys
  api_token: "hunter2-canary"	  api_token: "[redacted]"
  api_token: hunter2-canary	  api_token: [redacted]
- api_token: hunter2-canary	- api_token: [redacted]

# query strings
?access_token=hunter2-canary&page=2	?access_token=[redacted]&page=2
https://api.example.test/v1/items?signature=hunter2-canary&page=2	https://api.example.test/v1/items?signature=[redacted]&page=2

# Bearer
Authorization: Bearer hunter2-canary	Authorization: Bearer [redacted]
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer hunter2-canary" https://api.example.test	curl -H "Authorization: Bearer [redacted]" https://api.example.test

# URL userinfo
mysql://lando:hunter2-canary@db:3306/lando	mysql://[redacted]@db:3306/lando

# typed literal and quoted colon forms
PASSWORD=true	PASSWORD=[redacted]
password: "hunter2-canary"	password: "[redacted]"

# references and sentinels stay readable
API_TOKEN: "[redacted]"	API_TOKEN: "[redacted]"
token: "${DB_PASSWORD}"	token: "${DB_PASSWORD}"
DB_PASSWORD: "${secret:DB_PASSWORD}"	DB_PASSWORD: "${secret:DB_PASSWORD}"
